en-US.longDescription:
The newly designed 8BitDo Ultimate Software V2 is a one-stop solution for your 8BitDo devices. You can use it to configure keys, macros and a series of other professional-grade features as per preference, keep your devices up to date.

Features
- Key Mapping
  - Modify and disable certain key functions to create your own profile.
- Macros
  - Multiple complex instructions combos can be triggered with just a single keystroke.
- Firmware Update
  - Keep your devices up-to-date and in the best condition.
- Lighting
  - Adjust lighting effects and colors.
en-US.name: 8BitDo Ultimate Software V2
